name: Supervisor queue shows an empty state when there are no pending requests

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'empty.supervisor@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'Supervisor Queue' page via the sidebar link (URL /approvals/supervisor).
Verify the empty state is shown: the page contains the text 'No requests waiting for your approval' and the explanation 'New requests from your assigned direct reports will appear here'.
